purpose: Reproduce and justify the probe's initial measurement-expression correction.

contractBasis.event: The scenario requires exact data payload framing; absent id/event fields are not part of the expected input.
contractBasis.comment: WHATWG ignores comment lines; the scenario only requires recognizing the OpenRouter heartbeat comment.

error.name: AssertionError
error.message:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  {
    data: 'ok',
+   event: undefined,
+   id: undefined
  }

error.name: AssertionError
error.message:
Expected values to be strictly equal:
+ actual - expected

+ 'OPENROUTER PROCESSING'
- ' OPENROUTER PROCESSING'

retainedObservation: eventsource-parser 4.1.0 removes one optional space after ':' for onComment although its packaged README says it retains that space; this extension mismatch does not alter SSE event framing.
